exact_reference: Finite-horizon enumeration over public latent world family; rational posterior updates and floating-point losses; no realised hidden state or seed input.
independent_review: The teaching-example arithmetic and the evaluation protocol were independently reviewed. Wording was corrected to keep scoring definitions public while protecting realised private state.
prototype_scope: Four seasons / eight phases; not the proposed full civic campaign.
known_limits: No actual LLM benchmark, no provider integrations or API calls.
Only one binary persistent hidden condition and fixed public likelihood family.
No stakeholder consent, negotiation, institutional succession, inquiry delay, or mechanism drift.
The default full-run controls do not distinguish the ignore_blending error; dedicated diagnostics are reported separately.
The belief-0.4 checkpoint is a hypothetical supplied checkpoint, not sampled from default initial-sensor histories.
The additional reachable checkpoint was selected for a mechanism contrast, not sampled for unbiased performance estimation.
Separate referee process/tool access is a deployment requirement; local files alone do not enforce contestant isolation.
Public decision reasons are not graded by the small engine.
The public terminal penalty is a stipulated finite toy model, not a justified valuation of an infinite future.
scope: Historical validation of the frozen v0.1 kernel before the newly commissioned review and model pilot.
